# The scanners the security check runs, pinned by version and SHA-256.
# .github/scripts/fetch-pinned.sh reads this file; CI uses the linux-x64 rows, a Mac the darwin-arm64 rows.
#
# Where each hash comes from (check it again when you bump a row):
#   gitleaks, actionlint, osv-scanner, forge  the release's own checksums file
#                                             (*_checksums.txt, osv-scanner_SHA256SUMS, foundry_*.sha256)
#   solc                                      binaries.soliditylang.org/<platform>/list.json
#   zizmor, shellcheck                        no checksums file is published: GitHub's asset digest
#                                             (gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/releases/tags/<tag> --jq '.assets[].digest')
#
# Pick a release at least 7 days old, as Dependabot's cooldown does for everything else.
# Columns: tool version platform sha256 member url
#   member  the file inside the archive to install, or - for a bare binary
